Latin word

molestia

molestia, molestiae f.

noun, first declension

trouble, bother, annoyance

In this lexicon

  • problem

    also used · classical · Cic. Tusc. 4.18: molestia aegritūdō permanēns, a lasting distress

  • trouble

    the recommended word · classical · Cic. Fam. 9.25.3: molestiā Fadium līberā; Traupman 398: molestiam gravem alicui exhibēre, to cause someone big trouble; Traupman 149; Traupman 214: ingēns molestia, a big pain in the neck
